notes.title: The game is out - enjoy the demo version! ✨
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Demo is out - it's time to jump into the Magic Pussy universe once again in its prequel, telling the story of young Percival trying to solve the mystery of powerful artifacts and an enigmatic cult all while exploring a cozy village of Wisterwood. 

If you've played the previous chapters - note that this demo is longer than the whole chapter 1, so it's definitely worth a try! A whole week of story, a new approach to animations and a varying plot with choices that influence the outcomes - the full version will feature many different endings. 

Dive into the game and feel free to let us know about your experience - consider joining our Discord server for fast support and direct connection with a developer team. Violet's back, young versions of well-known characters are here and a lot of new enticing ones are waiting for you - all spiced-up with a long-awaited introduction of longer animated scenes and orgasms! 

This demo gives you just a glimpse - we’re working on 4 more weeks of content that will be available in the full version!

Download the demo now and experience the adventure for yourself - we'll keep the work going! 🎮
